title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
constraints: All values of nums are unique.
nums is an ascending array that is possibly rotated.
Return an index when found; otherwise return -1.

examples.explanation: A two-item rotation still has one sorted half at every step.

solutionApproaches.title: Linear Scan
solutionApproaches.explanation: Check each position in order; correct but does not meet the required logarithmic runtime.

solutionApproaches.title: Binary Search with Half-Sorted Check
solutionApproaches.explanation: One half around mid is always sorted. Decide which half contains target and recurse into it.
